issues.legal_issue: A landowner who accepts agreed acquisition compensation without protest under a written agreement excluding further claims cannot subsequently recover interest for the period before the agreement.
material_facts: The land was taken before compensation was determined and paid.
The landowner entered into a written agreement for compensation under the applicable agreement rules.
The agreement stated that the landowner would not claim any amount beyond the agreed compensation and would accept it without protest.
The landowner accepted the agreed compensation without protest, and it was paid on the date the agreement was signed.
The agreed compensation was a package accepted voluntarily and was higher than the compensation fixed for claimants who did not enter into such agreements.
issues.conclusion: The landowner could not claim additional interest for the period between the taking of possession and the agreement and payment; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 11(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, interested persons may agree in writing on matters to be included in the award, and the Collector may make an award on those terms. Read with Sections 23 and 34, such an agreement and an award accepted without protest are binding: the agreed compensation is treated as just compensation, including interest due up to the agreement, and a clear undertaking not to claim further amounts bars a later claim for that interest. State of Gujarat v. Daya Shamji Bhai and State of Karnataka v. Sangappa Dyavappa Biradar establish that agreed compensation accepted without protest forecloses further statutory benefits or enhancement; Shree Vijay Cotton & Oil Mills Ltd. v. State of Gujarat was distinguishable because it concerned an ordinary acquisition without an agreement. Equitable considerations did not alter the result given the voluntarily accepted package and payment when the agreement was made.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_case and written_compensation_agreement and agreement_excludes_additional_claims and accepted_without_protest

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_case: The proceeding concerns compensation for land acquired by a public authority.
predicates.written_compensation_agreement: The landowner and the acquiring authority agreed in writing on the compensation to be included in the award.
predicates.agreement_excludes_additional_claims: The agreement states that the landowner will not claim compensation beyond the agreed amount.
predicates.accepted_without_protest: The landowner accepted the agreed compensation without protest.

issues.definition: When a land-acquisition compensation case involves a written compensation agreement excluding additional claims and the landowner accepts the compensation without protest, the landowner is barred from claiming additional interest.
